about_the_game:
⚡ Duelyst: Blitz is a lightning-fast reimagining of the beloved tactical card battler Duelyst.

  • Engage in dynamic, turn-based duels where every move matters. With a streamlined 6-mana cap and a consistent 2-card draw each turn, Duelyst: Blitz delivers tight, decision-rich gameplay that rewards smart plays and bold tactics.

  • Build your deck from a diverse roster of powerful units and spells, each brought to life with stunning hand-animated pixel art. Position your forces on the battlefield, outthink your opponent, and strike with perfect precision. Whether you’re a returning Duelyst veteran or a newcomer to tactical card games, Blitz offers the perfect mix of accessibility and depth.

⚡ First truly cross-platform version of Duelyst. 📱 

  • iOS, Android and Steam releases 🍎 🤖

  • improved client performance 🏃‍♀️

  • touch (swipe) gestures support ☝️

  • 6 max mana, 60 seconds per turn ⏳

  • based on early Duelyst mechanics - 2 draw, no Bloodbound Spell 🧙

  • all profit from Orb purchases goes back into advertising budget (ads, influencer marketing, prized tournaments) 💸
